description: This file defines data structures, callback types, enums, and function prototypes for handling netlink message callbacks in a C project. It includes callback function typedefs, callback action and kind enums, and functions for managing callback structures.

methods.name: nl_cb_get
methods.description: Increments the reference count of the callback structure and returns it.

methods.name: nl_cb_set_all
methods.description: Sets all callback types in the callback structure to a specified function and argument.

methods.name: nl_cb_overwrite_recvmsgs
methods.description: Replaces the internal nl_recvmsgs callback with a user-defined function.

methods.name: nl_cb_overwrite_recv
methods.description: Replaces the internal nl_recv callback with a user-defined function.

methods.name: nl_cb_overwrite_send
methods.description: Replaces the internal nl_send callback with a user-defined function.
